Request channel status

Authorized request channel awaiting confirmation

The approved access, correction and deletion request destination is not connected to this preview. The handling process and identity-verification instructions also need confirmation. No request can be submitted on this page.

What would you like help with?

These describe the type of request to discuss through the authorized process. Available options depend on that process and the relevant information.

Access to information

Identify the account information or records you are asking about, then follow the instructions in the authorized request channel.

Correcting information

Identify the detail you believe needs correction. Use the approved process to provide the relevant context and any requested verification.

Deleting information

Explain the information or account you want to ask about. Read the applicable process for its scope, conditions and next steps.

Before using a request channel

  1. Check the destination

    Use the authorized Orb process once it is available. The website preview is not a place to upload identity documents or health records.

  2. Follow the stated instructions

    Provide the information and verification requested by that process. This preview does not define verification requirements or response times.

  3. Look for confirmation there

    A request is submitted only when the connected service confirms it. Keep any confirmation or reference it provides.

Questions about requests

Has opening this page submitted a request?
No. Reading this page or opening a destination panel does not submit an access, correction or deletion request.
Can I send my health documents here?
No. This page does not accept documents or personal information. Use only the instructions provided by an authorized request service when it becomes available.
How long will a request take?
No response time is established by this preview. Check the approved process for its handling information once it is available.
